album_art_only.description: Show only the album artwork (no text).
album_art_only.label: Album art only

audio_spectrum.description: Draw a live audio band meter in the chip.
audio_spectrum.label: Audio spectrum

desktop_active_color.description: Color of the current lyric line and the karaoke word highlight.
desktop_active_color.label: Active line color

desktop_color.description: Color of the regular lyric lines.
desktop_color.label: Text color

desktop_font_size.description: Font size of the lyric lines, 8-96.
desktop_font_size.label: Lyrics font size

desktop_lines.description: Minimum lyric lines in the desktop widget; short tracks fill more.
desktop_lines.label: Lyric lines

desktop_shadow.description: Drop shadow behind the lyric text; helps on a busy wallpaper.
desktop_shadow.label: Text shadow

desktop_show_artist.description: Show the artist line under the title on the desktop widget.
desktop_show_artist.label: Show artist

desktop_show_cover.description: Show the album artwork on the desktop widget.
desktop_show_cover.label: Show album art

desktop_width.description: Content width in logical pixels. Keep the editor box on auto (0) so the surface hugs the content.
desktop_width.label: Widget width

desktop_word_sweep.description: Sweep the highlight word by word through the current line. Off: the whole line is highlighted at once (line by line).
desktop_word_sweep.label: Word-by-word highlight

hide_album_art.description: Hide the artwork and its fallback icon.
hide_album_art.label: Hide album art

hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget while playback is paused.
hide_when_idle.label: Hide when paused

hide_when_no_media.description: Hide the widget when no MPRIS player is active.
hide_when_no_media.label: Hide when no media

local_lyrics_dir.description: Folder with local .lrc files named 'Artist - Title.lrc'; searched before LRCLIB.
local_lyrics_dir.label: Local lyrics folder

max_length.description: Maximum widget length in pixels — the text area width (long titles scroll or truncate to fit it).
max_length.label: Max length

offset_ms.description: Shift lyric timing in milliseconds (range -2000 to 2000). Positive values show lines earlier, negative values later.
offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset (ms)

panel_size.description: Size preset of the lyrics panel: compact (440), medium (520), large (640). The bar widget and control-center tile open this preset.
panel_size.label: Panel size

player_allowlist.description: Comma-separated player names (identity or bus name). When set, only matching players are shown. Empty = show any player.
player_allowlist.label: Player allowlist

player_blocklist.description: Comma-separated player names (identity or bus name) to hide. Empty = hide none.
player_blocklist.label: Player blocklist

show_lyric_line.description: Show the current synced lyric line in the chip instead of the artist (title stays).
show_lyric_line.label: Show current lyric line

title_scroll.description: Scroll long titles that exceed the max length.
title_scroll.label: Title scroll

source_order.description: Which online lyric provider to ask first. Comma separated, e.g. "netease, lrclib". A provider left out keeps its default place at the end.
source_order.label: Lyrics source order

use_cache.description: Store fetched lyrics in the plugin data directory for offline reuse.
use_cache.label: Cache lyrics
